Container.Name: Delta
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted personal finance. Delta connects your banks, cards and brokerages through Plaid and shows spending, budgets, recurring charges, investments and net worth. Open the WebUI and follow the checklist: add your own Plaid keys (free for personal use), connect accounts, pull your history. Your agent can read it over MCP with its own token.
Delta has no login. Keep it on your LAN or Tailscale, never port-forwarded.
Container.Requires: Plaid API keys (free for personal use). See https://zeapsu.github.io/Delta/docs/plaid-trial

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and agent API.

Config.Name: Allowed networks
Config.Description: Networks allowed to use the API (Plaid Link, sync, agents). Narrow to your LAN, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.

Config.Name: Agent URL
Config.Description: How agents reach Delta, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3000. Printed in the MCP configs.

Config.Name: Background jobs
Config.Description: Plaid sync every 6 hours and a daily backup, in this container.

Config.Name: Install type
Config.Description: Points the Update notice at app panel steps.
